title: Account
alert_text: The public log shows a key change for you that this computer did not make. If you did not add a device, tell your community organizer now.
name: Name
subject: Account ID
add_device_help: Install Anagram on the other computer and choose Restore your keys with your recovery kit. If it shows a device request, paste that request here.
kit_unsaved: You did not confirm that you saved your newest recovery kit.
kit_new_text: New recovery code. Your old kit no longer works.
kit_saved_busy: Deleting the copy on this computer…
guardians_now: Any {n} of {people} can help you get your keys back.
guardians_help: Choose colleagues on Anagram. Together, two of them can help you get your keys back. One alone cannot.
requests_help: Approve only after you talked to the person by phone or in person.
request: {person} asks for help to recover their keys.
request_bad: This request fails the checks. Do not approve it.
findable_on: On. Members who know your email address or ORCID iD can find you, for example to share work with you.
findable_off: Off. Members find you only in the member list.
signout_help: Ends your session with the community server. Your keys, findings, and sources stay on this computer.
orcid_link_help: Optional. A linked ORCID iD shows on your proof certificate and your preprint draft.
